overview.headline: Independence proposed and debated in the Second Continental Congress

keyPoints.point: Richard Henry Lee introduced a resolution that the united colonies ought to be free and independent states.
keyPoints.quote: On June 7, 1776, Richard Henry Lee introduced a resolution "that these united colonies are and of right ought to be free and independent states,"

keyPoints.point: The Lee Resolution contained three parts including a declaration of independence and a call to form foreign alliances.
keyPoints.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."

keyPoints.point: On June 11, 1776 Congress appointed three concurrent committees to draft declarations, alliances and a confederation plan.
keyPoints.quote: On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees in response to the Lee Resolution

keyPoints.point: The vote on the Lee Resolution showed affirmative votes from 12 colonies while New York did not vote until July 9, 1776.
keyPoints.quote: The document seen here shows the vote on the Lee Resolution — the affirmative votes of 12 colonies are listed at the right.

keyTerms.gloss: Proposal that contained three parts for independence and foreign alliances
keyTerms.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."

keyTerms.gloss: Colonial body in Virginia that gave instruction for introducing the resolution
keyTerms.quote: acting under the instruction of the Virginia Convention.

keyTerms.gloss: Governing body that met in Philadelphia and considered proposing independence for colonies
keyTerms.quote: to attend a Continental Congress that eventually became the governing body

keyTerms.gloss: Plan for union that took the form of a confederation for the states
keyTerms.quote: "prepare and digest the form of a confederation."

keyTerms.gloss: Hope of restored relations with Britain that delegates abandoned
keyTerms.quote: In less than a year, most of the delegates abandoned hope of reconciliation with Britain.
